description:
This week, Amazing Spider-Man: Spider-Versity writers Jordan Morris and Joe Kelly share what adventures are in store for the younger members of the Spider-Man family. Plus, we’ll get into the history of Ghost-Spider aka Gwen Stacy and Dan Slott discusses some of the more obscure and hilarious Spider-Variants from across the multiverse. All time codes are approximate. 

00:00 - Welcome Back!
1:11 - Writers Jordan Morris and Joe Kelly talk Amazing Spider-Man: Spider-Versity 
14:05 - History of Ghost-Spider (aka Gwen Stacy)
22:34 - Spider-Variants across the multiverse
